basic_info.description: Big Home Big Views - The Ultimate Retreat  Welcome to 23 Sparta Street, a modern marvel in Visitacion Valley built in 2017. Designed across three levels, this home is ideal for multi-generational living or those seeking a versatile compound with privacy & shared spaces. An expansive great room greets you with walnut-stained oak floors, soaring ceilings & stunning Bay views framed by lush hillsides. The middle level is the heart of the home, seamlessly blending relaxed living with elegant entertaining. The top level offers three spacious bedrooms & two full baths, including an ensuite with direct access to a 387 sqft deck with acacia wood tiles, perfect for enjoying the fresh air & serene surroundings. The lower level features a luxurious primary ensuite with direct access to the private deck & backyard, a flex den/bonus room & an additional full bath, perfect for a guest suite, in-law unit, or private quarters. The gourmet kitchen boasts custom cabinetry, a refined island & a premium high-end Thermador 6-burner gas cooktop, flowing effortlessly into a refined dining area. Multiple terraces provide a tranquil outdoor retreat. Minutes from McLaren Park, Louis Sutter pickleball courts & Mission Blue Cafe, this home blends modern sophistication, functionality & a vibrant community.
